purpose: Give Aura Oracle permanent access to JANUS JSON-first mirror/reverse/deep-analysis capabilities, large-registry semantic ingestion, predictive text, information-gain questioning and bounded probabilistic forecasting while preserving scientific and command-authority firewalls.

geometry.canonical_spiral: ORIGIN_n -> FORWARD_n -> REVERSE_n -> HRAIN_STRUCTURAL_n -> INAIHR_ASSOCIATIVE_n -> INFORMATION_GAIN_n -> PREDICTIVE_PRIOR_n -> DEMIHEAD_n -> VERIFIED_RETURN_OR_HOLD_n -> ORIGIN_PRIME_(n+1)
laws: ORIGIN_PRIME_(n+1) MUST RECORD WHAT CHANGED FROM ORIGIN_n

axes.D1_FORWARD: Literal and local dependency pass from origin to tail.
axes.D2_REVERSE: Tail-to-origin pass recovering backward scope, contradictions, omitted prerequisites and late constraints.
axes.D3_HRAIN_STRUCTURAL: Graph topology, dependency, gate, cycle, bottleneck and symmetry projection compatible with LEFT_HRAIN / STRUCTURAL_CONTEXT.
axes.D4_INAIHR_ASSOCIATIVE: Semantic association, analogy, distant-link and counterexample projection compatible with RIGHT_INAIHR / ASSOCIATIVE_CONTEXT.
axes.D5_SPIRAL_ABSTRACTION: Move across abstraction levels, then descend to source anchors; surviving state becomes an ORIGIN_PRIME candidate rather than returning to the same state.

large_dump_strategy: never require the full registry corpus in RAM
stream oversized JSON arrays/objects with ijson
cache file fingerprints and skip unchanged files
store source path and JSON path provenance for every indexed record

predictive_input.purpose: Typing acceleration and next-token/next-phrase suggestions, distinct from world-event forecasting.
predictive_input.output: ranked suggestions with scores and provenance

semantic_layer.default_retrieval: FTS/BM25 + lexical semantic overlap + graph context

twenty_questions_engine.question_policy: maximize expected entropy reduction / information gain
twenty_questions_engine.registry_mode: top semantic matches may become temporary candidates; discriminating features produce next questions

predictive_ai.scope: probabilistic forecast proposals and calibration, not prophecy
